label: prf:q-zero-complex-extension
title: Proof of q zero complex extension
html:
Each substrate identity is stated in the cited literature (Wenzl 1988; Jones 1987) over a commutative ring with q a unit; the substrate identities used here (the bi-filtration of H_q, the explicit central idempotent, the categorical q-Lie bracket and the bar involution) are likewise stated over a commutative ring R (or a stronger structure) with q \in R and without any ordering predicate on q.

The condition \lvert q \rvert > 1 on \mathbb{C} is sufficient to make q a unit (since \lvert q \rvert > 0 implies q \neq 0), so the existing polymorphic identities specialize. \quad\square
